comment: Everything docs/COMPARISON.md compares against, pinned. A competitor is fetched into the gitignored _upstream/ directory at exactly this commit (or npm version) and nowhere else. `copy: true` is allowed only for an MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD or ISC licence; an unlicensed skill is run and never copied into this repository.

considered.name: danger-js
considered.why: Its checks are rules the project writes itself in a Dangerfile and it needs a live pull request to read; it ships no built-in check of what a commit or pull request body says, so there is nothing to run on the same messages.

considered.name: git-commit-msg-linter
considered.why: A commit-msg hook that checks the header's type, scope and length against the Angular format; its README describes no rule about what the message body says, so there is no body check to run on the same messages.
